title: Mic produces no signal
shortDescription: SM7B or similar delivers no level to the interface.
fullDescription: The Shure SM7B is a dynamic mic that needs a lot of gain (+60dB or more). New owners often mistake low gain or a cable/input issue for a dead mic. Verify the cable, input gain, and that phantom power is correctly off (unless running a Cloudlifter which passes 48V through).

fixSteps.title: Increase gain or add inline preamp

whenToCallPro: If known-good cable + ample gain still silent, service mic.

title: Condenser won't power up
shortDescription: Phantom power switch off or inadequate.
fullDescription: Condenser mics (KSM8 with some config, KSM32, KSM137, SM27) need 48V phantom. Dynamic mics (SM7B, SM58) do not. Phantom power on a Cloudlifter feeding the SM7B is required for the Cloudlifter itself — not the mic.

fixSteps.title: Enable 48V at interface
fixSteps.instruction: Press the +48V button; some interfaces require channel-specific activation.

fixSteps.title: Use external PSU on bus-limited interfaces
fixSteps.instruction: Some laptop-powered interfaces lack amps for phantom.

videoSearchQuery: Shure phantom power not working fix

faq.a: Not generally — check manufacturer. Most Shure ribbons are vintage and very sensitive.

title: Overdriven input
fullDescription: Too much gain, extremely loud source, or pad switch off cause clipping. Engage the pad on KSM series (-15 dB), reduce gain, or move mic farther.

fixSteps.title: Engage pad
fixSteps.instruction: Flip -15 dB pad on mic or interface.

faq.a: Not in most cases, but on snare rim hits it helps.

title: SLX-D / BLX / QLX-D transmitter not pairing
fullDescription: Shure wireless systems pair via IR sync or auto-scan. Interference on the selected group/channel, low TX battery, or a mismatch between TX and RX frequency band cause pairing failures.

fixSteps.title: Run auto-scan
fixSteps.instruction: RX Menu > Scan > pick clean frequency.

fixSteps.title: IR sync TX
fixSteps.instruction: Align IR ports ~15 cm apart and press Sync.

fixSteps.title: Fresh batteries
fixSteps.instruction: Use full alkalines or Shure rechargeable.

whenToCallPro: If scan reveals no clean frequencies — hire RF coordinator.

faq.q: Can I use two systems on same frequency?

title: Wireless pack battery depleted
fullDescription: Shure TX units use AA or Shure SB900 rechargeables. Cold and high output power shorten runtime. Use fresh cells before a show.

title: Frequency interference causing drops
fullDescription: UHF wireless can clash with TV broadcast, Wi-Fi, or other wireless mics. Use Wireless Workbench for coordination. Antenna placement and line-of-sight help.

fixSteps.title: Rescan for clean channel
fixSteps.instruction: RX menu > scan; assign unused group.

fixSteps.title: Improve antenna placement
fixSteps.instruction: Line of sight, off floors/walls, 1-3 m away from RX body.

whenToCallPro: For large venues or 6+ channel systems.

faq.a: Less FCC constraint but more crowded by Wi-Fi.

title: Excessive plosive energy
fullDescription: SM7B has internal pop filter but close-mic plosives still pass through. Add external pop filter and angle the mic 15-30 degrees off-axis.

fixSteps.title: Angle mic off-axis
fixSteps.instruction: Point slightly past mouth, not straight at it.

faq.a: Pop filter better for studio; windscreen for outdoor.

title: Mains hum in signal
fullDescription: Ground loops, unshielded cables near power, or USB-powered devices cause hum. Isolate, reroute cables, or use a hum eliminator.

fixSteps.title: Reroute XLR away from power cables
Use Ebtech Hum-X or isolation transformer

videoSearchQuery: Shure microphone hum ground loop fix

faq.a: Unsafe on gear with 3-prong power — use isolation instead.

title: Loose capsule assembly
shortDescription: Physical rattle audible when mic is moved.
fullDescription: After drops, SM58/SM57 capsules can loosen. Unscrew the grille and gently tighten. If capsule is damaged, Shure sells the R59 (SM58) and R57 (SM57) capsule replacement units.

fixSteps.title: Replace capsule
fixSteps.instruction: R59 for SM58, R57 for SM57.

videoSearchQuery: Shure SM58 capsule rattle R59 replacement

faq.a: Yes, use genuine R-series parts for correct tone.

title: MV7 / MV7+ USB whine or hiss
shortDescription: USB hub or port generates noise.
fullDescription: Shure MV7/MV7+ can pick up USB-bus noise on laptops with PD charging or on unpowered hubs. Use a direct port, disable USB charging while recording.

faq.a: MV7 XLR output bypasses USB preamp entirely.
